title: From the Heel of Italy
tagline: From the heel of Italy to the nations
description: Updates from the Pieno Vangelo ministry and the Ronchi family: our church in Modugno, Il Rifugio, missions and church planting across Puglia and beyond.
author: Pastor Mirko Ronchi

areas.name: Family Life
areas.intro: Personal news from Pastor Mirko and family: what God is doing in our home, how we are doing, and how you can pray for us.

areas.name: Church Life
areas.intro: Pieno Vangelo (Full Gospel) Church in Modugno, near Bari, was born in the 1970s from a Dutch missionary work. News on events, new projects, initiatives and the vision we are pursuing for our city.

areas.name: Loving the Nations Among Us
areas.intro: Many have come to Puglia from far away, leaving behind hardship and danger in search of a better life for their families. We don't want them to feel like strangers here. We long to welcome them with open arms, to love them as Christ has loved us, and to serve them through friendship, practical help and our after-school program, so that they can find a home among us and come to know the love of Jesus.

areas.name: Plant & Strengthen
areas.intro: Planting new churches across Puglia, a region where many towns still have no living church, and standing alongside existing churches that need support to keep going.

areas.name: To the Ends of the Earth
areas.intro: Sending workers beyond our borders and preparing young people to go: training, departures and stories from those we send.

areas.name: Il Rifugio Center
areas.intro: Il Rifugio, in Ruvo di Puglia, is a place of welcome and rest, where churches and ministries are refreshed, workers are trained and the Church is built up.
